message.content: {"11036_8353800735802": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The chest X-ray shows a large, lobulated anterior mediastinal mass with ill-defined margins and bilateral pleural effusions, which are features highly suggestive of an aggressive malignancy like thymic carcinoma rather than a benign lesion."}, "11036_8353800736450": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The presence of a lobulated anterior mediastinal mass accompanied by bilateral pleural effusions is the most indicative finding of an invasive anterior mediastinal tumor with potential vascular or pleural involvement."}, "11036_8353800736462": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The mass is located in the anterior mediastinum and obscures the hilar vessels (hilum-overlay sign), while the associated bibasal pleural effusions strongly suggest malignant spread consistent with thymic carcinoma."}}
